question: For ports that are bound to the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, port status, allocated IP address, and the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network ordered by standard attribute ID. Do not repeat the network ID if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per network showing the number of ports and the maximum running-sum value. Do not return any rounded answers.
